newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan must deepen fiscal reforms - IMF official.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan must deepen fiscal reforms - IMF official.

text.p: Venezuela must deepen its fiscal reforms if is to achieve inflation targets, a visiting International Monetary Fund official said.

"Positive steps have been taken but they have to be consolidated if the country is to return to growth," Carlos Muniz, head of a visiting IMF team, told reporters after the weekly economic cabinet meeting.
"It's important that fiscal reforms are deepened if inflation is to fall to levels closer to the targets fixed at the beginning (of the economic reform program)," he said.

Although Venezuelan inflation has steadily fallen from a 12.6 percent peak in May after the country implemented a tough series of IMF-supported reforms in mid-April, government officials have said year-end monthly inflation targets of 1.5 percent will not be met.
November inflation was 3.1 percent. Central Bank governor Antonio Casas Gonzalez recently said December inflation would be around two percent.
